findings.title: Using === for dayjs object comparison will always return false as it compares object references, not values. Use .isSame
findings.description: Using === for dayjs object comparison will always return false as it compares object references, not values. Use .isSame() method instead: dayjs(date.start).add(utcOffset, 'minutes').isSame(dayjs(date.end).add(utcOffset, minutes))
